description: Main React component for the notes frontend page, managing notes display, editing, and user interactions.

methods.name: HomePage
methods.description: React component rendering the main notes application interface, handling user auth, note CRUD operations, filtering, and UI states.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Sets the note as selected for editing and opens the modal.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a note after user confirmation and clears selection if needed.

methods.name: onSelect
methods.description: Sets a note as selected for viewing or editing.

methods.name: onNewNote
methods.description: Prepares to create a new note by opening the editor modal.

methods.name: handleSaveNote
methods.description: Handles saving a note, either by creating or updating, then refreshes notes list and closes modal.
